paper.title_en: Light-Transformed Carrollian OPEs and the Four-Gluon Spectral Bootstrap
paper.abstract_en: Scattering amplitudes of massless particles can be rewritten as correlation functions of light-transformed operators at null infinity, on which the Carrollian symmetries act. We ask how much of the four-gluon tree amplitude is determined by the operator product expansion of these operators. When two gluons become collinear, the exchanged gluon and all of its descendants combine into a single function of the null time of $\mathcal{I}^+$ and angular separations of the pair on the celestial sphere. We show that this function is fixed by the Ward identities, which reduce to Kummer's differential equation, and by the signs of the energies, which select one combination of its two solutions. We then expand the same amplitude in massive two-particle states of the physical scattering channel and find that the collinear data control the expansion at large spin. Each of the two collinear poles of the amplitude determines one of the two infinite sequences of partial-wave coefficients in closed form. Once both poles are imposed, crossing symmetry and the scaling of the correlator in Carroll time fix the tree spectrum uniquely among amplitudes with only the physical collinear poles, up to a single subtraction constant at the collinear boundary.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文在类光无穷远上利用Carrollian对称性与光变换算符研究四胶子树振幅的算符乘积展开决定程度，通过Ward恒等式化为Kummer方程并分析共线极点与部分波展开，理论深度与新颖性较高，且明确属于引力基础/渐近对称性方向，值得点入进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 光变换Carrollian OPE与四胶子谱Bootstrap
decision.abstract_zh: 无质量粒子的散射振幅可以重写为类光无穷远处光变换算符的关联函数，Carrollian对称性作用于这些算符。我们追问四胶子树振幅在多大程度上由这些算符的算符乘积展开所决定。当两个胶子变为共线时，被交换的胶子及其所有后代结合为$\mathcal{I}^+$的类光时间与该对在天球上角间隔的单一函数。我们证明该函数由Ward恒等式（其约化为Kummer微分方程）以及能量的符号（其从两个解中选出一个组合）所固定。随后我们在物理散射道的大质量两粒子态中展开同一振幅，并发现共线数据在大自旋下控制该展开。振幅的两个共线极点各自以闭式决定两个无限部分波系数序列之一。一旦施加两个极点，交叉对称性以及关联函数在Carroll时间中的标度行为在仅含物理共线极点的振幅中唯一地固定了树级谱，直至共线边界处的一个减除常数。
